INSERT INTO public.sync_errors (
    run_id,
    workflow_name,
    workflow_execution_id,
    stage,
    node_name,
    category,
    http_status,
    github_request_id,
    attempt,
    retryable,
    safe_message
)
VALUES (
    ($1::jsonb ->> 'run_id')::BIGINT,
    $1::jsonb ->> 'workflow_name',
    $1::jsonb ->> 'workflow_execution_id',
    $1::jsonb ->> 'stage',
    $1::jsonb ->> 'node_name',
    $1::jsonb ->> 'category',
    NULLIF($1::jsonb ->> 'http_status', '')::INTEGER,
    $1::jsonb ->> 'github_request_id',
    NULLIF($1::jsonb ->> 'attempt', '')::INTEGER,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF($1::jsonb ->> 'retryable', '')::BOOLEAN,
        false
    ),
    $1::jsonb ->> 'safe_message'
)
RETURNING
    id,
    run_id,
    occurred_at,
    workflow_execution_id;
